notes: The him of that heard him is added: the Hebrew participle has no object morpheme, and rule 44 forbids folding an unsupported object into the verb's unit.
אֶל and the לְ of מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה are both unrepresented under rule 40, the one word without carrying the whole relation.
Both jussive frames (let ... lay, let ... stone) join their verbs' units under rule 17 and are discontinuous around the subjects under rule 25.
